description: An acceptance test states an expected timeout outcome, while observations explicitly say the test was not run. Compare requirement and implementation/configuration without treating the expectation as an actual result.

documents.text: R-003: Document extraction shall have a hard processing timeout of 45 seconds per file. A timeout shall result in a terminal failed job state and a user-readable error.
AT-005: Submit a PDF fixture that takes longer than 45 seconds to extract. Expected result: a terminal failed job state and a user-readable timeout error.
PDF extraction runs in a worker process. The worker timeout is configured to 60 seconds. If the worker times out, the job manager records a failed state with a generic message.
OBS-005: No slow-extraction fixture was run. The 45-second acceptance criterion remains unverified by this observation set.
